resolutions.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE — CONFIRMED. IGAT 10 (خط دهم سراسری گاز, the 'loop'/لوپ line) is a real, well-documented Iranian gas trunkline. The gem.wiki page rests on a single 2014 Iran Daily forecast ('IGAT-10 to come online in December', 28 Oct 2014) — thin support on its own — but multiple independent sources confirm the physical line. CLASSIFICATION — CONFIRMED gas transmission trunk (a large-diameter reinforcement/loop line for the central corridor, supplying Isfahan and central provinces previously fed by IGAT 1/2/4). Not gathering/process/plant-internal; not oil/NGL. DUPLICATE — none: it is the only IGAT 10 in the 31-row Iran roster; not a segment double-count of another PID (distinct Kangan→Isfahan loop). GulfPub's 'IGAT 10 | Bushehr Province → Saveh, 56 in, 393 km' is the same physical line (fuzzy endpoint/length; GulfPub's Capacity_mmcfd=300 is a placeholder, ignored). SPEC — length 632 km and capacity 2472.03 MMcf/d both CORROBORATED: naftema.com and Persian industry sources give 632 km and 70 MMcm/d, and 70 MMcm/d × 35.3147 = 2472.03 MMcf/d exactly (i.e. GEM's oddly precise figure is just the metric 70 MMcm/d converted). digital-oil-gas-map.com lists 597 km (as-built route length) — minor. NOTE English Wikipedia repeats GEM's exact '2,472.03 MMcf/d' and the same Iran Daily cite, so it is circular, NOT independent — excluded. Diameter blank in GEM; both independent sources give 56 in (staged as a fill). ATTRIBUTION caveats: End location 'Tiran' does not match the sourced terminus (Pol Kaleh CS, Lanjan county, Esfahan) — province correct, city likely wrong; operator/owner: gas trunklines are NIGC/IGTC (Ministry of Petroleum ultimate owner is defensible), GulfPub's 'NIOC' is the oil company and is wrong for a gas line. StartYear1=2014 rests only on the 2014 forecast article while compressor stations (e.g. Pol Kaleh) came online ~2023-2024, so 2014 is at best partial first-gas.

resolutions.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: unambiguously real.
